senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be good, fit, handsome, valuable.

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:5">Gen. R. s. 26</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00093"><he>טַבָּת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 83">Gen. R. s. 83</cite> (play on <he>מהיטבאל</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 36:39">Gen. XXXVI, 39</cite>) <he>מְטִיבֵי אלוהות היו</he> they were dressers of idols; <he>שהיו מֵטִיבִין עצמן וכ׳</he> they adorned themselves in honor of the idols.
Ib. מטיבי נשים וכ׳ they dressed women for their wedding; a. e.—Esp. (את הנרות) ה׳ to trim, cleanse the lamps.

senses.gloss: to turn a dream unto good (saying, ‘I have dreamt a good dream’).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 55b:4">Ber. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>יְטִיבֶנּוּ בפני וכ׳</he> he shall turn it in the presence of three persons, and say &c.

senses.gloss: to do good, be beneficent. Ib. IX, 2 הטוב והמטיב who is good and beneficent.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 31a:2">Taan. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>תקנו … הטוב והמ׳</he> they introduced in Jabneh the benediction ‘who is good &c.’ (in the grace after meal).—
Kidd. I, 10 מטיבין לו good will be done to him; a. fr.—Part. Hof. מוּטָב, q. v.

senses.gloss: to improve a field, to till oftener than usual. Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ top טִיְּיבָהּ וכ׳ if, after he improved a field, he died &c.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:2">Shebi. IV, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 3:10">Tosef. ib. III, 10</cite>; a. e.—Denom. <cite ref="I00338"><he>טִיּיוּב</he></cite>.
